description: Approved crates.io published names. Right-hand values are the published names; left-hand keys are in-repo crate names. Decided 2026-06-18.

notes.workspace-hack: The crates.io name 'workspace-hack' is taken by a generic hakari stub (0.1.0). We publish under 'vox-workspace-hack' instead. No in-repo rename needed — only the published package name changes via Cargo.toml [package] name override.
